evidence_limit: NASA identifies the objects in linked releases. Current crossings come from independent cartographic arrows or OSW schematic/editorial lines. The Indonesian Throughflow gate is an OSW conceptual feature line. Object locators are approximate points and regional movies are geographic context. None proves a NASA-segmented footprint, an observed current core, or an individual eddy track.

NASA's descriptive upper value; not a time-mean transport estimate.
NASA's Gulf Stream tour description; not a uniform temperature along the full current.

system_context.note: NASA calls the Gulf Stream another part of the ocean conveyor belt; this is a system relation, not a streamline boundary.

reported_properties.scope_note: NASA's stated possible eddy diameter near the eastward-meandering Gulf Stream; this is not current length or a diameter for every cold core.

NASA's 2025 page describes unnamed Gulf Stream cold cores this way. Published studies describe detached Gulf Stream cold-core rings as cyclonic. NASA may mean a differently scoped feature; no individual eddy is classified here and OSW does not adopt the NASA wording as a general polarity rule.
reported_properties.review_note: The cited Gulf Stream cold-core ring study describes detached cold-core rings as cyclonic. Its ring class may not be identical to the unnamed cold cores in NASA's tour.
